notes: The wool overlay is NOT the skin model inflated: ModelSheep2 is a separate class with its own box dimensions, and its texture is sheep_fur.png. Recovered from javap -c bqo. The fourth addBox argument is the inflation delta, which grows the rendered cube but never changes the UV net.

cubes.notes: ModelSheep2 head.addBox(-3,-4,-4,6,6,6, 0.6f) -- 6 deep, not 8: the head net is 24x12
ModelSheep2 legs addBox(-2,0,-2,4,6,4, 0.5f) -- half-height sleeve; the fur atlas paints a full 12-tall leg but rows v26..31 are never sampled
